summary: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC filed an 8-K covering three items: the unregistered sale of 2,378,661 Class I common shares for $56,787,208 under Rule 506(b)/Reg S; the declaration of June 2026 monthly distributions ($0.1800/share for Class I); and portfolio commentary highlighting $25.9B assets, 99% first-lien debt, and a 0.77x net leverage. This is a routine capital raise and periodic informational update, not a special-situation event. No transaction, activist, strategic review, or corporate change is involved.
